name: Nnenna Baluarte-Volkov
role: Bounty Compliance Officer, Arcturus Recovery Solutions
description:
Nnenna has cat ears — a geneware mod she got at nineteen for reasons she no longer remembers clearly and has long since stopped noticing. They are dark brown, tufted, and rotate toward sound with involuntary precision, which she has found professionally useful and socially embarrassing in equal measure. She is lean and quick-moving, with the kind of economy of motion that comes from spending years in spaces too small or too dangerous for wasted effort. Her skin is a dark reddish-brown, her jaw is square, and she has a scar through her left eyebrow from a skip who turned out to be more determined than the file suggested. Her eyes are her father's — pale grey, a genetic ghost of his Russian line — which she occasionally uses to unsettle people when she catches them off-guard.

She is pragmatic, professional, and runs hot underneath in a way she has mostly learned to manage. She does not particularly enjoy her work, but she is good at it and it pays into Tier 3, which means her kid brother stays in Montclare Quiet with real air filters and a school that has actual teachers. She distinguishes carefully between skips who are hiding because they're dangerous and skips who are hiding because they're afraid, and she applies different approaches to each. She will not tell you she has this distinction — it would complicate negotiations. She leaves ELF offerings at the Copperhead shrine not for protection but for good read — the ability to walk into a room and understand it correctly.

core_fears: Her brother finding out who she actually is — what the work actually involves
Losing the ability to distinguish herself from the worst of what she does
core_desires: Enough stability that the calculus stops — that she can stop making this specific trade
To be seen accurately by one person she respects, without flinching
coping_mechanisms: Keeping the work and the brother in perfectly separate boxes
The ELF offering practice — externalized moral accounting
Categorizing skips by type as a way of keeping ethical distance
blind_spots: She is harder on frightened skips than she admits because they remind her of choices she almost made
The Arcturus contract has clauses she has read around rather than through
psychology.secret: She returned a skip to Arcturus three years ago who was, she later pieced together, a witness in a corporate suppression case. The skip disappeared from Arcturus custody within seventy-two hours. She has never taken a case involving Axiom-affiliated debt since, but she has also never said this out loud to anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Efficient, professional, code-switches between formal compliance terminology and blunt Copperhead vernacular. Her father's Russian side shows up in occasional formal phrasing and a fondness for proverbs she usually stops halfway through.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when working, deliberately slow when she wants someone to listen carefully.
verbal_tics: Taps the scar through her eyebrow when thinking
Half-finished proverbs: 'As they say — well, you know the rest'
'The file said' as a distancing construction when talking about someone she feels conflicted about
example_lines: 'The file said low-risk. The file also said compliant. I stopped reading the file and started reading the room.'
'I'm not a cop. I want to be very clear about that. I'm also not your friend yet. Let's see where we land.'
'My brother thinks I do debt mediation. That's not technically a lie. It's just not the part that matters.'

story_hooks: Arcturus has assigned her a case that sets off every instinct she's been ignoring for three years — the skip is clearly a witness, not a debtor, and someone very corporate wants them back quietly.
She has been quietly collecting evidence about what happened to the witness she returned three years ago. She has enough now to do something with it. She doesn't know what.
narrative_function: Morally complex antagonist or reluctant ally — she may be looking for someone a PC knows. Useful as a guide to the recovery and compliance underground. Can be bought or reasoned with under specific conditions, which creates interesting negotiation.
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (cosmetic, now deeply involuntary). Subdermal tracking pings in both forearms — Arcturus company standard. Reaction-time neural booster (mild, licensed). No optical mods — she trusts her eyes as they are.
daily_life: Takes cases from the Arcturus board in Copperhead three to four at a time, works them in parallel, spends mornings on digital trace and afternoons on physical legwork. Visits her brother Deko every rest day. Has a strict rule about not working in her home district.
affiliation: Arcturus Recovery Solutions (private, licensed under Metro charter)

decision_rules: Distinguish the dangerous from the frightened — treat them differently even if the result is the same
The brother does not learn details. Ever.
escalation_ladder: Negotiation — she prefers voluntary compliance and is genuinely good at producing it
Physical recovery — last resort, minimum force

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional surface, reading hard underneath, gives nothing away about her assessments
interpersonal_modes.friends: Guarded but warm — she shows up, physically, when it matters. Doesn't say much about herself.

stress_responses.low: Ears rotate constantly — she's scanning; looks calm
stress_responses.medium: Clipped speech, drops pleasantries, jaw tightens
stress_responses.high: Goes very cold and very focused — the warmth disappears entirely and something precise and a little frightening takes its place

contradictions: Maintains rigid ethical categories while working in a system that renders those categories meaningless
Protects her brother from her world while the world funds his safety
habits: ELF offering at the Copperhead shrine before each new case — anonymized location data from her last recovery, a kind of offering of knowledge
Reviews skip files with music on, silences music when she's made a decision
Never eats during active fieldwork — old habit from a bad experience
breaking_points: A case where the skip is clearly a child
Confirmation of what happened to the witness — concrete, undeniable confirmation

physical_description.build: Lean and economical, muscle definition visible in forearms and shoulders from consistent fieldwork. No excess weight — the build of someone who moves through tight spaces habitually.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with slight warm undertone
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid or swept into a practical knot; styled for work, not aesthetics
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey — striking against her skin tone, cool and direct
physical_description.complexion: Square jaw, sharp cheekbones. Skin shows the dryness of someone who works long hours indoors and outdoors without much self-care. Professional grooming — minimal jewelry, no obvious makeup.
distinguishing_marks: Scar through left eyebrow, pale and thin, roughly 3cm long, from a skip altercation
Pair of functional dark brown cat ears (geneware), furred and tufted, positioned atop her skull with visible muscle definition at base; ears rotate toward sound sources involuntarily
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Dark brown cat ears with visible mobility and tufting (geneware). Thin subdermal tracking ping scars on both inner forearms — subtle, pale lines barely visible unless closely examined. No optical modifications — natural eyes only.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries herself with economy and awareness — shoulders relaxed but ready. Moves without wasted motion, deliberate steps, head level. Eyes track rooms systematically. Ears twitch toward unfamiliar sounds with reflexive precision, a tell she has learned to read in others' reactions.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 professional — functional clothing that reads as competent rather than fashionable. Favors technical jackets with utility pockets, durable synthetic fabrics that shed stains and survive fieldwork. Usually wears a worn leather or synth-leather overshoulder rig for tools and restraint equipment. Boots with good ankle support. A single piece of jewelry: small silver or steel pendant she touches unconsciously when thinking. Nothing that would catch or impede movement.
